newsitem.title: RWANDA: Firing heard near Bukavu airport in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Firing heard near Bukavu airport in Zaire.

text.p: Journalists and refugees in the Rwandan border town of Cyangugu said they heard firing from the direction of Bukavu airport in Zaire on Sunday but it was not clear who held it.
Reuters Television Producer Tony Wende said he heard what sounded like mortar bombs explode on Sunday and Saturday night from the direction of the airport north of the Zairean border city of Bukavu.
"We can see a plume of smoke rising from fighting in what appears to be in front of the airport," added Wende in Cyangugu.

Several Rwandan refugees who crossed from Bukavu on Sunday said they had also heard shooting and some explosions from near the airport during the same interval but it was unclear whether either side was gaining the upper hand in fighting.

Bukavu was seized by Banyamulenge ethnic Tutsi rebels last Wednesday after Zairean troops and unruly militiamen pulled out to the north in the direction of the airport, 20 km (12 miles) from the city.
